steps.say: Claude Code just got mods, and most people have no idea what they can do.
title: Claude Code
just got mods.

steps.say: A mod is a small JavaScript plugin that changes how Claude Code looks and behaves.
title: Change how
Claude Code works.

card.title: Claude Code · first mod
card.credit: real recording · Claude Code docs, Mods overview

steps.say: Here are three ways to use them. One, a mod can send a message to another of your sessions, so one chat hands work to the next.
title: Your sessions
talk to each other.

card.credit: docs: a mod can send a message to another of your sessions

steps.say: Two, it can send a request to a different model, so easy tasks stop burning your best one.
title: Easy tasks,
cheaper model.

card.credit: docs: send one request to a different model

steps.say: Three, it can draw its own panel inside Claude Code, with tabs and buttons, like a dashboard for your to-dos.
title: Build your own
dashboard.

card.title: Claude Code · /hello-tabs
card.credit: real recording · Claude Code docs, Draw in the interface

steps.say: Just know a mod runs with your permissions, so only install ones you trust.
title: Only install
mods you trust.
